title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Rebecca Richman Cohen is an Emmy-nominated documentary filmmaker who has taught at Harvard Law School since 2011. Her courses examine the intersections of criminal justice, human rights, and visual culture, exploring how documentary film constructs legal meaning and shapes the stories we tell about accountability and harm.
